answer: The vintner walks the rows in March and ties a ribbon to every vine that will bear, because a vine without a ribbon is not picked. Coroner appointment with judicial appointments commission attestation is the ribbon's proof: ten-year legal practice, appointment by commission, oath on file, tenure record. A jade that slips past the count is one basket of grapes the press never saw, and the ridge is the price of that basket, paid in coin to the estate before the harvest is weighed. The lantern is the estate roll, signed by the steward and locked in the manor chest.
